title: Words Like Knives: Backstory-Personalized Modeling and Detection of Violent Communication
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLMs using the Nonviolent Communication (NVC) framework, specifically benchmarking their ability to identify 'Moralistic Judgments' and other forms of 'violent' vs. 'nonviolent' communication. It evaluates models on tasks that require understanding interpersonal moral values and judgment.
